[Article] According to Philippines media, 
Taehyung’s Coca Cola advertisements will take over the streets of Manila, Bonifacio Global City (BGC) to the massive billboards along C5, EDSA Northbound, and EDSA Ortigas Southbound.

V is Here! Coca-Cola® Zero Sugar Welcomes Global Superstar BTS V as New Brand Ambassador

The wait is over! V of 21st century pop icons BTS has officially joined the Coca-Cola Zero Sugar family — bringing his unmatched artistry, signature charisma, and captivating energy to the #/AllOutSarapWithZeroCalories campaign in the Philippines.

MANILA, November 18, 2025 – V, a renowned singer, songwriter, and member of BTS, is set to take refreshment to the next level as the newest ambassador for Coca-Cola Zero Sugar. On November 17, 2025, Coca-Cola lit up its official social media channels with a striking first campaign visual — the global superstar showcasing his signature cool gaze alongside the bold, refreshing taste of Coke® Zero Sugar.

V’s authentic and magnetic presence – defined by his artistic depth, effortless charm, and uncompromising spirit – is the perfect embodiment of the Coca-Cola Zero Sugar campaign: celebrating life’s best moments, all-out, with zero guilt.
